ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud crackdown in Minnesota and its impact on care workers and clients
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the connections between entities involved in the Medicaid fraud crackdown
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are care workers and clients being affected by the crackdown?
ideas.insight: I believe that there may be more to the Medicaid fraud crackdown in Minnesota than meets the eye. By following the money and investigating the connections between entities involved, we may be able to uncover a larger scheme.
